arabic: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Alif-Laaam-Raa; tilka Aayaatul Kitaabi wa Qur-aa-nim Mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
translations.en.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.
translations.en.yusufali: A. L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur'an that makes things clear.
translations.id.indonesian: Alif, laam, raa. (Surat) ini adalah (sebagian dari) ayat-ayat Al-Kitab (yang sempurna), yaitu (ayat-ayat) Al Quran yang memberi penjelasan.

arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rubamaa yawaddul lazeena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen

translations.en.sahih: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
translations.en.pickthall: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.
translations.en.yusufali: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to Allah's will) in Islam.
translations.id.indonesian: Orang-orang yang kafir itu seringkali (nanti di akhirat) menginginkan, kiranya mereka dahulu (di dunia) menjadi orang-orang muslim.

arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Zarhum yaakuloo wa tatamatta'oo wa yulhihimul amalu fasawfa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!
translations.en.yusufali: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them).
translations.id.indonesian: Biarkanlah mereka (di dunia ini) makan dan bersenang-senang dan dilalaikan oleh angan-angan (kosong), maka kelak mereka akan mengetahui (akibat perbuatan mereka).

arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
transliteration: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa wa lahaa kitaabum ma'loom

translations.en.sahih: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
translations.en.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.
translations.en.yusufali: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tiada membinasakan sesuatu negeripun, melainkan ada baginya ketentuan masa yang telah ditetapkan.

arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
transliteration: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon

translations.en.sahih: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
translations.en.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.
translations.en.yusufali: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada suatu umatpun yang dapat mendahului ajalnya, dan tidak (pula) dapat mengundurkan(nya).

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
transliteration: Wa qaaloo yaaa aiyuhal lazee nuzzila 'alaihiz Zikru innaka lamajnoon

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!
translations.en.yusufali: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Hai orang yang diturunkan Al Quran kepadanya, sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar orang yang gila.

arabic: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Law maa taateenaa bil malaaa'ikati in kunta minas saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
translations.en.pickthall: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?
translations.en.yusufali: "Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa kamu tidak mendatangkan malaikat kepada kami, jika kamu termasuk orang-orang yang benar?"

arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
transliteration: Maa nunazzilul malaaa'i kata illaa bilhaqqi wa maa kaanooo izam munzareen

translations.en.sahih: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.
translations.en.pickthall: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.
translations.en.yusufali: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have!
translations.id.indonesian: Kami tidak menurunkan malaikat melainkan dengan benar (untuk membawa azab) dan tiadalah mereka ketika itu diberi tangguh.

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nazalnaz Zikra wa Innaa lahoo lahaa fizoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.
translations.en.yusufali: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami-lah yang menurunkan Al Quran, dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar memeliharanya.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya'il awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
translations.en.pickthall: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.
translations.en.yusufali: We did send messengers before thee amongst the religious sects of old:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus (beberapa rasul) sebelum kamu kepada umat-umat yang terdahulu.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
transliteration: Wa maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

translations.en.sahih: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
translations.en.pickthall: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.
translations.en.yusufali: But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidak datang seorang rasulpun kepada mereka, melainkan mereka selalu memperolok-olokkannya.

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
transliteration: kazaalika naslukuhoo fee quloobil mujrimeen

translations.en.sahih: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:
translations.en.yusufali: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners -
translations.id.indonesian: Demikianlah, Kami mamasukkan (rasa ingkar dan memperolok-olokkan itu) kedalam hati orang-orang yang berdosa (orang-orang kafir),

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Laa yu'minoona bihee wa qad khalat sunnatul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
translations.en.pickthall: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.
translations.en.yusufali: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka tidak beriman kepadanya (Al Quran) dan sesungguhnya telah berlalu sunnatullah terhadap orang-orang dahulu.

arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
transliteration: Wa law fatahnaa 'alaihim baabam minas samaaa'i fazaloo feehi ya'rujoon

translations.en.sahih: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
translations.en.pickthall: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,
translations.en.yusufali: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan jika seandainya Kami membukakan kepada mereka salah satu dari (pintu-pintu) langit, lalu mereka terus menerus naik ke atasnya,

arabic: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
transliteration: Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmum mashooroon

translations.en.sahih: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
translations.en.pickthall: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.
translations.en.yusufali: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."
translations.id.indonesian: tentulah mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya pandangan kamilah yang dikaburkan, bahkan kami adalah orang orang yang kena sihir".

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqad ja'alnaa fissamaaa'i buroojanw wa zaiyannaahaa linnaazireen

translations.en.sahih: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.
translations.en.yusufali: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan gugusan bintang-bintang (di langit) dan Kami telah menghiasi langit itu bagi orang-orang yang memandang(nya),

arabic: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa hafiznaahaa min kulli Shaitaanir rajeem

translations.en.sahih: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
translations.en.pickthall: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,
translations.en.yusufali: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every cursed devil:
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami menjaganya dari tiap-tiap syaitan yang terkutuk,

arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Illaa manis taraqas sam'a fa atba'ahoo shihaabum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
translations.en.pickthall: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
translations.en.yusufali: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see).
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali syaitan yang mencuri-curi (berita) yang dapat didengar (dari malaikat) lalu dia dikejar oleh semburan api yang terang.

arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
transliteration: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli shai'im mawzoon

translations.en.sahih: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.
translations.en.yusufali: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah menghamparkan bumi dan menjadikan padanya gunung-gunung dan Kami tumbuhkan padanya segala sesuatu menurut ukuran.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha wa mal lastum lahoo biraaziqeen

translations.en.sahih: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
translations.en.pickthall: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah menjadikan untukmu di bumi keperluan-keperluan hidup, dan (Kami menciptakan pula) makhluk-makhluk yang kamu sekali-kali bukan pemberi rezeki kepadanya.

arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
transliteration: Wa im min shai'in illaa 'indanaa khazaaa 'inuhoo wa maa nunazziluhooo illaa biqadarim ma'loom

translations.en.sahih: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.
translations.en.pickthall: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.
translations.en.yusufali: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidak ada sesuatupun melainkan pada sisi Kami-lah khazanahnya; dan Kami tidak menurunkannya melainkan dengan ukuran yang tertentu.

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa arsalnar riyaaha la waaqiha fa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa asqai naakumoohu wa maaa antum lahoo bikhaazineen

translations.en.sahih: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
translations.en.pickthall: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah meniupkan angin untuk mengawinkan (tumbuh-tumbuhan) dan Kami turunkan hujan dari langit, lalu Kami beri minum kamu dengan air itu, dan sekali-kali bukanlah kamu yang menyimpannya.

arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
transliteration: Wa innnaa la nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa nahnul waarisoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya benar-benar Kami-lah yang menghidupkan dan mematikan dan Kami (pulalah) yang mewarisi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
transliteration: Wa la qad 'alimnal mustaqdimeena minkum wa laqad 'alimnal mustaakhireen

translations.en.sahih: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.
translations.en.yusufali: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah mengetahui orang-orang yang terdahulu daripada-mu dan sesungguhnya Kami mengetahui pula orang-orang yang terkemudian (daripadamu).

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka Huwa yahshuruhum; innahoo Hakeem 'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.
translations.en.yusufali: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah yang akan menghimpunkan mereka. Sesungguhnya Dia adalah Maha Bijaksana lagi Maha Mengetahui.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

translations.en.sahih: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
translations.en.pickthall: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
translations.en.yusufali: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia (Adam) dari tanah liat kering (yang berasal) dari lumpur hitam yang diberi bentuk.

arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
transliteration: Waljaaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris samoom

translations.en.sahih: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
translations.en.pickthall: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.
translations.en.yusufali: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah menciptakan jin sebelum (Adam) dari api yang sangat panas.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
transliteration: Wa iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa' ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

translations.en.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
translations.en.pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah), ketika Tuhanmu berfirman kepada para malaikat: "Sesungguhnya Aku akan menciptakan seorang manusia dari tanah liat kering (yang berasal) dari lumpur hitam yang diberi bentuk,

arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
transliteration: Fa izaa sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

translations.en.sahih: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
translations.en.pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
translations.en.yusufali: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila Aku telah menyempurnakan kejadiannya, dan telah meniup kan kedalamnya ruh (ciptaan)-Ku, maka tunduklah kamu kepadanya dengan bersujud.

arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
transliteration: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon

translations.en.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
translations.en.pickthall: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together
translations.en.yusufali: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bersujudlah para malaikat itu semuanya bersama-sama,

arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
transliteration: Illaaa ibleesa abaaa ai yakoona ma'as saajideen

translations.en.sahih: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
translations.en.pickthall: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.
translations.en.yusufali: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali iblis. Ia enggan ikut besama-sama (malaikat) yang sujud itu.

arabic: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
transliteration: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma'as saajideen

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves?"
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Hai iblis, apa sebabnya kamu tidak (ikut sujud) bersama-sama mereka yang sujud itu?"

arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
transliteration: Qaala lam akul li asjuda libasharin khalaqtahoo min salsaalim min hama im masnoon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!
translations.en.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape."
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Iblis: "Aku sekali-kali tidak akan sujud kepada manusia yang Engkau telah menciptakannya dari tanah liat kering (yang berasal) dari lumpur hitam yang diberi bentuk"

arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
transliteration: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa innaka rajeem

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed.
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Keluarlah dari surga, karena sesungguhnya kamu terkutuk,

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Wa inna 'alikal la'nata ilaa Yawmid Deen

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.
translations.en.yusufali: "And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment."
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya kutukan itu tetap menimpamu sampai hari kiamat".

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
translations.en.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata iblis: "Ya Tuhanku, (kalau begitu) maka beri tangguhlah kepadaku sampai hari (manusia) dibangkitkan,

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
transliteration: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Respite is granted thee
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "(Kalau begitu) maka sesungguhnya kamu termasuk orang-orang yang diberi tangguh,

arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
transliteration: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom

translations.en.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
translations.en.pickthall: Till the Day of appointed time.
translations.en.yusufali: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
translations.id.indonesian: sampai hari (suatu) waktu yang telah ditentukan,

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi bimaaa aghwaitanee la uzayyinaana lahum fil ardi wa la ughwiyan nahum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,
translations.en.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong,-
translations.id.indonesian: Iblis berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, oleh sebab Engkau telah memutuskan bahwa aku sesat, pasti aku akan menjadikan mereka memandang baik (perbuatan maksiat) di muka bumi, dan pasti aku akan menyesatkan mereka semuanya,

arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
transliteration: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen

translations.en.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
translations.en.pickthall: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.
translations.en.yusufali: "Except Thy servants among them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali hamba-hamba Engkau yang mukhlis di antara mereka".

arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
transliteration: Qaala haaza Siraatun 'alaiya Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "This (way of My sincere servants) is indeed a way that leads straight to Me.
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Ini adalah jalan yang lurus, kewajiban Aku-lah (menjaganya).

arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
transliteration: Inna 'ibaadee laisa laka 'alaihim sultaanun illaa manittaba'aka minal ghaaween

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,
translations.en.yusufali: "For over My servants no authority shalt thou have, except such as put themselves in the wrong and follow thee."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya hamba-hamba-Ku tidak ada kekuasaan bagimu terhadap mereka, kecuali orang-orang yang mengikut kamu, yaitu orang-orang yang sesat.

arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Wa inna jahannama lamaw'iduhum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily, Hell is the promised abode for them all!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Jahannam itu benar-benar tempat yang telah diancamkan kepada mereka (pengikut-pengikut syaitan) semuanya.

arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
transliteration: Lahaa sab'atu abwaab; likulli baabim minhum juz'um maqsoom

translations.en.sahih: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."
translations.en.pickthall: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.
translations.en.yusufali: To it are seven gates: for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.
translations.id.indonesian: Jahannam itu mempunyai tujuh pintu. Tiap-tiap pintu (telah ditetapkan) untuk golongan yang tertentu dari mereka.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.
translations.en.yusufali: The righteous (will be) amid gardens and fountains (of clear-flowing water).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa itu berada dalam surga (taman-taman) dan (di dekat) mata air-mata air (yang mengalir).

arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
transliteration: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin aamineen

translations.en.sahih: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
translations.en.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.
translations.en.yusufali: (Their greeting will be): "Enter ye here in peace and security."
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Masuklah ke dalamnya dengan sejahtera lagi aman"

arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
transliteration: Wa naza'naa ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan 'alaa sururim mutaqaabileen

translations.en.sahih: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
translations.en.pickthall: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.
translations.en.yusufali: And We shall remove from their hearts any lurking sense of injury: (they will be) brothers (joyfully) facing each other on thrones (of dignity).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami lenyapkan segala rasa dendam yang berada dalam hati mereka, sedang mereka merasa bersaudara duduk berhadap-hadapan di atas dipan-dipan.

arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
transliteration: Laa yamas suhum feehaa nasabunw wa maa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen

translations.en.sahih: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
translations.en.pickthall: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.
translations.en.yusufali: There no sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak merasa lelah di dalamnya dan mereka sekali-kali tidak akan dikeluarkan daripadanya.

arabic: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Nabbi' 'ibaadeee annneee anal Ghafoorur Raheem

translations.en.sahih: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
translations.en.yusufali: Tell My servants that I am indeed the Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful;
translations.id.indonesian: Kabarkanlah kepada hamba-hamba-Ku, bahwa sesungguhnya Aku-lah Yang Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang,

arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
transliteration: Wa anna 'azaabee uwal 'azaabul aleem

translations.en.sahih: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.
translations.en.yusufali: And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty.
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwa sesungguhnya azab-Ku adalah azab yang sangat pedih.

arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
transliteration: Wa nabbi'hum 'an daifi Ibraaheem

translations.en.sahih: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
translations.en.pickthall: And tell them of Abraham's guests,
translations.en.yusufali: Tell them about the guests of Abraham.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kabarkanlah kepada mereka tentang tamu-tamu Ibrahim.

arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
transliteration: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala innaa minkum wajiloon

translations.en.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."
translations.en.pickthall: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.
translations.en.yusufali: When they entered his presence and said, "Peace!" He said, "We feel afraid of you!"
translations.id.indonesian: Ketika mereka masuk ke tempatnya, lalu mereka mengucapkan: "Salaam". Berkata Ibrahim: "Sesungguhnya kami merasa takut kepadamu".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
transliteration: Qaaloo la tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin 'aleem

translations.en.sahih: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Fear not! We give thee glad tidings of a son endowed with wisdom."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Janganlah kamu merasa takut, sesungguhnya kami memberi kabar gembira kepadamu dengan (kelahiran seorang) anak laki-laki (yang akan menjadi) orang yang alim".

arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
transliteration: Qaala abashshartumoonee 'alaaa am massaniyal kibaru fabima tubashshiroon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Ibrahim: "Apakah kamu memberi kabar gembira kepadaku padahal usiaku telah lanjut, maka dengan cara bagaimanakah (terlaksananya) berita gembira yang kamu kabarkan ini?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bilhaqqi falaa takum minal qaaniteen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "We give thee glad tidings in truth: be not then in despair!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kami menyampaikan kabar gembira kepadamu dengan benar, maka janganlah kamu termasuk orang-orang yang berputus asa".

arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
transliteration: Qaala wa mai yaqnatu mir rahmati Rabbiheee illad daaaloon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, but such as go astray?"
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim berkata: "Tidak ada orang yang berputus asa dari rahmat Tuhan-nya, kecuali orang-orang yang sesat".

arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
transliteration: Qaala famaa khatbukum aiyuhal mursaloon

translations.en.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?
translations.en.yusufali: Abraham said: "What then is the business on which ye (have come), O ye messengers (of Allah)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata (pula) Ibrahim: "Apakah urusanmu yang penting (selain itu), hai para utusan?"

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin,
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kami sesungguhnya diutus kepada kaum yang berdosa,

arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Illaaa Aala Loot; innaa lamunajjoohum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
translations.en.pickthall: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,
translations.en.yusufali: "Excepting the adherents of Lut: them we are certainly (charged) to save (from harm),- All -
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali Luth beserta pengikut-pengikutnya. Sesungguhnya Kami akan menyelamatkan mereka semuanya,

arabic: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
transliteration: Illam ra atahoo qaddarnaaa innahaa laminal ghaabireen

translations.en.sahih: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
translations.en.pickthall: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.
translations.en.yusufali: "Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, will be among those who will lag behind."
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali istrinya. Kami telah menentukan, bahwa sesungguhnya ia itu termasuk orang-orang yang tertinggal (bersama-sama dengan orang kafir lainnya)".

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
transliteration: Falamma jaaa'a Aala Lootinil mursaloon

translations.en.sahih: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
translations.en.pickthall: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,
translations.en.yusufali: At length when the messengers arrived among the adherents of Lut,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tatkala para utusan itu datang kepada kaum Luth, beserta pengikut pengikutnya,

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
transliteration: Qaala innakum qawmum munkaroon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Ye appear to be uncommon folk."
translations.id.indonesian: ia berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu adalah orang-orang yang tidak dikenal".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Yea, we have come to thee to accomplish that of which they doubt.
translations.id.indonesian: Para utusan menjawab: "Sebenarnya kami ini datang kepadamu dengan membawa azab yang selalu mereka dustakan.

arabic: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
transliteration: Wa atainaaka bilhaqqi wa innaa lasaadiqoon

translations.en.sahih: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
translations.en.pickthall: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.
translations.en.yusufali: "We have brought to thee that which is inevitably due, and assuredly we tell the truth.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kami datang kepadamu membawa kebenaran dan sesungguhnya kami betul-betul orang-orang benar.

arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
transliteration: Fa asri bi ahlika biqit'im minal laili wattabi' adbaarahum wa laa yaltafit minkum ahadunw wamdoo haisu tu'maroon

translations.en.sahih: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
translations.en.pickthall: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.
translations.en.yusufali: "Then travel by night with thy household, when a portion of the night (yet remains), and do thou bring up the rear: let no one amongst you look back, but pass on whither ye are ordered."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pergilah kamu di akhir malam dengan membawa keluargamu, dan ikutlah mereka dari belakang dan janganlah seorangpun di antara kamu menoleh kebelakang dan teruskanlah perjalanan ke tempat yang di perintahkan kepadamu".

arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
transliteration: Wa qadainaaa ilaihi zaalikal amra anna daabira haaa'ulaaa'i maqtoo'um musbiheen

translations.en.sahih: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
translations.en.pickthall: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.
translations.en.yusufali: And We made known this decree to him, that the last remnants of those (sinners) should be cut off by the morning.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan telah Kami wahyukan kepadanya (Luth) perkara itu, yaitu bahwa mereka akan ditumpas habis di waktu subuh.

arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa jaaa'a ahlul madeenati yastabshiroon

translations.en.sahih: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
translations.en.pickthall: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).
translations.en.yusufali: The inhabitants of the city came in (mad) joy (at news of the young men).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan datanglah penduduk kota itu (ke rumah Luth) dengan gembira (karena) kedatangan tamu-tamu itu.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
transliteration: Qaala inna haaa'ulaaa'i daifee falaa tafdahoon

translations.en.sahih: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!
translations.en.yusufali: Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not:
translations.id.indonesian: Luth berkata: "Sesungguhnya mereka adalah tamuku; maka janganlah kamu memberi malu (kepadaku),

arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
transliteration: Wattaqul laaha wa laa tukhzoon

translations.en.sahih: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."
translations.en.pickthall: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!
translations.en.yusufali: "But fear Allah, and shame me not."
translations.id.indonesian: dan bertakwalah kepada Allah dan janganlah kamu membuat aku terhina".

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Qaalooo awalam nanhaka 'anil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
translations.en.pickthall: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone?
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Did we not forbid thee (to speak) for all and sundry?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Dan bukankah kami telah melarangmu dari (melindungi) manusia?"

arabic: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
transliteration: Qaala haaa'ulaaa'i banaateee in kuntum faa'ileen

translations.en.sahih: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "There are my daughters (to marry), if ye must act (so)."
translations.id.indonesian: Luth berkata: "Inilah puteri-puteriku (kawinlah dengan mereka), jika kamu hendak berbuat (secara yang halal)".

arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
transliteration: La'amruka innahum lafee sakratihim ya'mahoon

translations.en.sahih: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
translations.en.pickthall: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication, they wander in distraction, to and fro.
translations.id.indonesian: (Allah berfirman): "Demi umurmu (Muhammad), sesungguhnya mereka terombang-ambing di dalam kemabukan (kesesatan)".

arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
transliteration: Fa akhazat humus saihatu mushriqeen

translations.en.sahih: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
translations.en.pickthall: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.
translations.en.yusufali: But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka dibinasakan oleh suara keras yang mengguntur, ketika matahari akan terbit.

arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
transliteration: Faja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa amtamaa 'alaihim hijaaratam min sjijjeel

translations.en.sahih: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
translations.en.pickthall: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.
translations.en.yusufali: And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami jadikan bahagian atas kota itu terbalik ke bawah dan Kami hujani mereka dengan batu dari tanah yang keras.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil lilmutawassimeen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! in this are Signs for those who by tokens do understand.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi orang-orang yang memperhatikan tanda-tanda.

arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa innahaa labi sabeelim muqeem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.
translations.en.yusufali: And the (cities were) right on the high-road.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya kota itu benar-benar terletak di jalan yang masih tetap (dilalui manusia).

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatal lilmu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! in this is a sign for those who believed.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa in kaana Ashaabul Aikati lazaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.
translations.en.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: And the Companions of the Wood were also wrong-doers;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya adalah penduduk Aikah itu benar-benar kaum yang zalim,

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Fantaqamnaa minhum wa innahumaa labi imaamim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
translations.en.pickthall: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.
translations.en.yusufali: So We exacted retribution from them. They were both on an open highway, plain to see.
translations.id.indonesian: maka Kami membinasakan mereka. Dan sesungguhnya kedua kota itu benar-benar terletak di jalan umum yang terang.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqad kazzaba ashaabul Hijril mursaleen

translations.en.sahih: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.
translations.en.pickthall: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.
translations.en.yusufali: The Companions of the Rocky Tract also rejected the messengers:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya penduduk-penduduk kota Al Hijr telah mendustakan rasul-rasul,

arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
transliteration: Wa aatainaahum Aayaatinaa fakaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
translations.en.pickthall: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.
translations.en.yusufali: We sent them Our Signs, but they persisted in turning away from them.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami telah mendatangkan kepada mereka tanda-tanda (kekuasaan) Kami, tetapi mereka selalu berpaling daripadanya,

arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa kaanoo yanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan aamineen

translations.en.sahih: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
translations.en.pickthall: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.
translations.en.yusufali: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure.
translations.id.indonesian: dan mereka memahat rumah-rumah dari gunung-gunung batu (yang didiami) dengan aman.

arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
transliteration: Fa akhazat humus saihatu musbiheen

translations.en.sahih: But the shriek seized them at early morning.
translations.en.pickthall: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,
translations.en.yusufali: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka dibinasakan oleh suara keras yang mengguntur di waktu pagi,

arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
transliteration: Famaaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon

translations.en.sahih: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
translations.en.pickthall: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.
translations.en.yusufali: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)!
translations.id.indonesian: maka tak dapat menolong mereka, apa yang telah mereka usahakan.

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
transliteration: Wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaaa illaa bilhaqq; wa innas Saa'ata la aatiyatun fasfahis safhal jameel

translations.en.sahih: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
translations.en.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.
translations.en.yusufali: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah Kami ciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya, melainkan dengan benar. Dan sesungguhnya saat (kiamat) itu pasti akan datang, maka maafkanlah (mereka) dengan cara yang baik.

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Inna Rabbaka Huwal khallaaqul 'aleem

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.
translations.en.yusufali: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah Yang Maha Pencipta lagi Maha Mengetahui.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaaka sab'am mnal masaanee wal Qur-aanal 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
translations.en.pickthall: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah berikan kepadamu tujuh ayat yang dibaca berulang-ulang dan Al Quran yang agung.

arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Laa tamuddanna 'ainaika ilaa maa matta 'naa biheee azwaajam minhum wa laa tahzan 'alaihim wakhfid janaahaka lilmu 'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
translations.en.pickthall: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.
translations.en.yusufali: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers.
translations.id.indonesian: Janganlah sekali-kali kamu menunjukkan pandanganmu kepada kenikmatan hidup yang telah Kami berikan kepada beberapa golongan di antara mereka (orang-orang kafir itu), dan janganlah kamu bersedih hati terhadap mereka dan berendah dirilah kamu terhadap orang-orang yang beriman.

arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
transliteration: Wa qul inneee anan nazeerul mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
translations.en.pickthall: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,
translations.en.yusufali: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity,"-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku adalah pemberi peringatan yang menjelaskan".

arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
transliteration: Kamaaa anzalnaa 'alal muqtasimeen

translations.en.sahih: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
translations.en.pickthall: Such as We send down for those who make division,
translations.en.yusufali: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),-
translations.id.indonesian: Sebagaimana (Kami telah memberi peringatan), Kami telah menurunkan (azab) kepada orang-orang yang membagi-bagi (Kitab Allah),

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
transliteration: Allazeena ja'alul Quraana'ideen

translations.en.sahih: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
translations.en.pickthall: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.
translations.en.yusufali: (So also on such) as have made Qur'an into shreds (as they please).
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) orang-orang yang telah menjadikan Al Quran itu terbagi-bagi.

arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Fawa Rabbika lanas'a lannahum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
translations.en.pickthall: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka demi Tuhanmu, Kami pasti akan menanyai mereka semua,

arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: 'Ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon

translations.en.sahih: About what they used to do.
translations.en.pickthall: Of what they used to do.
translations.en.yusufali: For all their deeds.
translations.id.indonesian: tentang apa yang telah mereka kerjakan dahulu.

arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
transliteration: Fasda' bimaa tu'maru wa a'rid anil mushrikeen

translations.en.sahih: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
translations.en.pickthall: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sampaikanlah olehmu secara terang-terangan segala apa yang diperintahkan (kepadamu) dan berpalinglah dari orang-orang yang musyrik.

arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
transliteration: Innaa kafainaakal mustahzi'een

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,
translations.en.yusufali: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami memelihara kamu daripada (kejahatan) orang-orang yang memperolok-olokkan (kamu),

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Allazeena yaj'aloona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhar; fasawfa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.
translations.en.yusufali: Those who adopt, with Allah, another god: but soon will they come to know.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) orang-orang yang menganggap adanya tuhan yang lain di samping Allah; maka mereka kelak akan mengetahui (akibat-akibatnya).

arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqad na'lamu annak yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon

translations.en.sahih: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
translations.en.pickthall: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,
translations.en.yusufali: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami sungguh-sungguh mengetahui, bahwa dadamu menjadi sempit disebabkan apa yang mereka ucapkan,

arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
transliteration: Fasbbih bihamdi Rabbika wa kum minas saajideen

translations.en.sahih: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
translations.en.pickthall: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).
translations.en.yusufali: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration.
translations.id.indonesian: maka bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu dan jadilah kamu di antara orang-orang yang bersujud (shalat),

arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
transliteration: Wa'bud Rabbaka hattaa yaatiyakal yaqeen

translations.en.sahih: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
translations.en.pickthall: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
translations.en.yusufali: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
translations.id.indonesian: dan sembahlah Tuhanmu sampai datang kepadamu yang diyakini (ajal).
